01 overview

A dark stage, rain made of light

Victor Lepri plays jazz piano in New York City. The brand is the room he plays in: a dark stage, rain made of light, a name that arrives glowing and stands alone.

Two sentences answer each other across everything he prints. ART IS TECHNOLOGY on the way in; TECHNOLOGY IS ART on the way out. One mono voice speaks every word. One four note prayer signs every surface. Nothing traditional: no navbar, no hero, no footer, no logo soup. Light on a grid, time in the spacing, Coltrane in the changes.

02 the mark

Four notes, four pixels

The mark is the chant of A Love Supreme: F, Ab, F, Bb, sounded as four lit pixels on an 8 by 8 grid. The horizontal axis is time and the gaps swing, 1 column, then 2, then 2. The glow pixel sings the last syllable. It is a constellation, not a logo; it reads at 16 pixels and at 16 feet.

dark ground
light ground
pixel column, row dark light note
a 1, 5 #e11a5f #c41555 F
love 2, 4 #ff3ea0 #e0287a Ab
su 4, 5 #e11a5f #c41555 F
preme 6, 3 #ffe0f0 #2a48ff Bb
  • Every cut keeps one empty column of breathing room before the first pixel; the mark never touches an edge.
  • On dark surfaces the chip matches the surface color exactly. On light surfaces blue takes over for glow.
  • The favicon is simply the mark on its chip; it is not a special cut.
  • Masters: mark-dark.svg, mark-light.svg, mark-favicon.svg.
03 the name

The name stands alone

The wordmark is the name set in the mono stack at weight 300 with wide tracking. No role words sit beneath it, no title, no tagline; the name carries the room by itself.

On the site the name speaks a 5 by 7 LED alphabet and is born inside two seconds of arrival. One LED voice everywhere, for the name, the nav, and the speaker icon alike: brightness lift 0.22, glow threshold 0.92, alpha floor 0.85; pink 255, 80, 172; pale 255, 224, 240. Brightness and pink share a word through the lift and threshold pair, never through hue alone.

06 writing

No dashes, ever

  • No hyphens or dashes of any kind, in a headline, a caption, or a commit message. Reword, or let a comma or a semicolon carry the beat.
  • Sentences run short and plain, lowercase where the surface allows it.
  • The slogans answer each other and never share one face: the card front asks, the back replies.
  • Everything is authored by Victor Lepri. No attribution trailers, no footers from tools.
07 motion and sound

The rain keeps its own time

  • The rain never reacts to the cursor.
  • The cursor never emits light; it only lifts and bends what already shines, and every parting decays the instant the hand rests.
  • The band arms once. Each visit deals one of four Coltrane heads: Giant Steps, Naima, Central Park West, A Love Supreme. The drops sound the tune note by note; muted, it keeps walking, so sound returns mid chorus like it never stopped.
  • The deep slow drops stay silent; no bass notes.
